description.narrative: The Global Week is a week of global exchange arranged around the national General Assembly of the YMCA and YWCA Denmark (YMCA-YWCA DK). Specifically, we wish to invite representatives from five international partners to the General Assembly, and through their participation raise awareness of YMCA and YWCA as global movements among our Danish members. Furthermore we will use their visit as a chance to set up a range of strategic meetings that allow existing project groups to work on their international activities and kickstart new ones. In particular, the Global Week will help support the Global Ambassador Program - a new initiative set out to make local associations all over Denmark involved in global matters. Cameroon YMCA (C-YMCA) is already a partner in this initiative, and the Global Week will allow them to visit several local associations and test drive the ideas that have been developed through the program so far.
